steam_and_heat.ponder.steam_engine.heade: Generating Rotational Force using the Steam Engine
steam_and_heat.ponder.steam_engine.text_: Steam Engines generate Rotational Force while Steam is provided
You can attach engines directly onto active boilers to run it at reduced stress capacity.
The provided Rotational Force has a very large stress capacity.
You may use pumps to pump steam so that you will get max stress capacity.
You can build a structure to make flywheels driving pumps itself.
Using Engines made of Steel or Cast Iron will increase efficiency and generated capacity of the Flywheel.
However, power up higher level of engine require higher amount of steam, boiler and burner should match the level.

steam_and_heat.ponder.dynamo.header: Generating Electric energy using a Dynamo
steam_and_heat.ponder.dynamo.text_1: The Dynamo generates electric energy (FE) from rotational force
steam_and_heat.ponder.dynamo.text_2: It requires at least 32 RPM to operate
steam_and_heat.ponder.dynamo.text_3: It's energy production is determined by the input RPM
steam_and_heat.ponder.dynamo.text_4: It has conversion efficiency of 75 Percent
steam_and_heat.ponder.dynamo.text_5: You can lock the Dynamo with redstone signal so it will not apply stress to the network
